# Processed data workspace (generated by the implementation)

No normalized or cleaned datasets are pre-generated in this handoff. Quoder should create generated working tables here, retaining source-to-row provenance and never editing the immutable source CSVs in `data/source_data/`.

Recommended subfolders:
- `normalized/` — field mappings and unit harmonization.
- `row_classified/` — data rows separated from notes, blank rows and repeated exports.
- `model_tables/` — branch-specific input/target tables created only after target approval.
- `time_series/` — calibrated frames/sensor timelines grouped by physical experiment.

Every generated file must include source file, source PSI ID/version, original row/test key, transformation version and missingness/quality flags.
